posts.cooked:
Hey everyone.

 

Work has been crazy. Were picking up for the fall wedding season, and lots of stuff going on. the little catering company i work for is expanding, and im getting more responsiblities as we do. Add to thta my daughter starting school this week, and a trip to europe in the works for later this month, ive been swamped.


And its not looking like its  coming up anytime soon.

 

So, I need someone to step up. If you have the time. Luckily the Wiki helps itself - i already see a ton of people updating as more info comes out, this is great! Keep up the work everyone!

 

The statistics sorta got some help,  but I noticed it stalled and I havent had the time to try and fix it. If you have any expereience with gdocs and want to help out, send me a PM. Ill get a couple of people who can help keep it running and going.

 

Arathorn, PM me your google account too, and Ill get you access to admin rights on the doc itself. That should help out your secondary page. 

 

Lets keep these projects alive, even if I can't!

 

Lynkfox
